_comment: Shared cases for the two column rules the dashboard had to copy from the TUI (#550):
the CTX percentage (internal/tui/context.go) and the permission-mode label
(internal/tui/mode.go). Both are read by internal/tui/column_shared_test.go and by
test/js/dashboard.test.mjs, which must agree case for case.
CTX cases stay off an exact .5 percentage: Go's %.0f rounds half to even and
Math.round rounds half up, and this fixture is not the place to discover that.

context.why: no reading at all is a dash, not a zero
a reading that happens to be zero is 0%, and #367 exists to keep these apart
an unknown family falls back to base
no model at all falls back to base
a non-numeric version part is zero, not a parsed prefix — strconv.Atoi rejects it
a negative reading clamps to zero rather than rendering a negative fill

mode.why: the safe default is named, not left raw
an unrecognised mode is surfaced raw — it must never read as the safe default (#304)
